Cut economy: every scissor cut is purposeful and confident — a shape that is straight in the real object is cut with a clean STRAIGHT edge, and curves appear ONLY where the real object is actually curved. No decorative wavy edges, no bumpy wobbly outlines, no gratuitous scalloping on untextured surfaces; a rectangular block is cut as a plain rectangle, though corners may be gently ROUNDED — softly rounding a corner is natural scissor work. Shapes stay simple and chunky, no detail finer than real scissors could cut. Scalloped repeat patterns for textures like straw or waves, cut big and loose. Strictly straight-on orthographic front view, zero perspective. No volume, no curvature, no folded paper, no sculpting. Real-scissors discipline: every piece is a shape that could actually be cut with scissors from a single sheet of colored paper. EACH PIECE IS EXACTLY ONE SOLID FLAT COLOR — no gradient, no shading, no airbrush, no painted detail inside a piece; every color change is a separate stacked paper piece, even a thin line is its own paper strip. ALL pieces share one identical fine colored-paper texture. All shadows are neutral warm dark-brown paper shadows, never colored. A layered paper-cut diorama scene seen straight-on: the scene is built from SIX to EIGHT flat paper layers one behind another (far sky, distant hills, middle ground, ground, near foreground), each layer a cut-paper silhouette casting a soft warm shadow on the layer behind, giving strong depth like a shadow-box. Leave the lower middle of the image open and uncluttered so characters can stand there. Scene: a FLOOR PLAN view — the camera looks STRAIGHT DOWN at a wooden plank floor, exactly like looking at a map: the ENTIRE image is floor from edge to edge, horizontal wooden plank strips running left to right across the whole sheet (each plank a separate flat honey-brown paper strip with a thin darker gap strip between planks), and in the centre a soft sage-green OVAL rug cut from one paper piece with a cream paper border ring. There is NO horizon, NO sky, NO hills, NO wall, NO window — nothing stands up, everything lies flat on the floor, because we are looking down from the ceiling. No furniture. A FULL-BLEED sheet filling the ENTIRE image edge to edge, no lime green, no characters. Colour mood: soft, muted, warm picture-book pastels with low saturation — honey and light wood browns, gentle warm light; never saturated, never dark. No text, no watermark.
